note: Calibrated from five local release runs on a fast development machine (4 vCPU class, Xvfb). Recalibrate after the first five runs on the CI runner: set baseline to the observed median, warn to about 1.75x and fail to about 3x. A fail breach is re-measured once; only a second breach fails the job. Sizes: warn at +8%, fail at +15%.

metrics.name: startup_median_ms
metrics.note: Median first-paint-ms of 10 fresh impro processes after one warm-up.

metrics.name: startup_ratio
metrics.note: Median impro first paint divided by the empty-window floor measured in the same run; independent of machine speed.

metrics.name: key_to_paint_ms
metrics.note: Median of window_qa performance open/switch/toggle key-to-paint timings.

metrics.name: graph_draw_p50_ms
metrics.note: graph_bench: settled 3,000-node graph at fit zoom, median draw.

metrics.name: idle_cpu_ticks
metrics.note: utime+stime clock ticks over 10 idle seconds, 3 seconds after start.

metrics.name: binary_size_mib
metrics.note: Size of the release impro binary.
